description: Sunset Strip's GTA 6 guide pages: the best player-made video guides for each question (money, cheats, missions, collectibles, cars, weapons, wanted level, heists, stealing cars, saving, controls, trophies, errors and more), checked by AI and refreshed every few hours. Pass a topic key or a few words ("lose wanted level", "cheats ps5") to get that page and its most-watched guide videos with a one-line summary of each; with nothing, it lists every guide page. Each page also exists in Spanish, Portuguese, German and French.
